checked_product.original_source_rule: Preserve the first literal finite range before deep reconstruction, including when a later limit is symbolic.
checked_product.operational_errors: Propagate checked-product failures as ValueError; no silent retry through the old unchecked rational path.

checksol.source_rule: Retain original equation sides, inverse bases and candidate replacement sources before simplification/substitution can erase a pole.
checksol.inconclusive_rule: Unresolved domains and unadmitted scalar/function owners remain None.
checksol.bounded_inputs: Shared iterative conjunction allowance, cycle/depth limits, bounded exact integers and string tokens, every sequential exponent prefix checked before materializing the parent power.
checksol.non_goal: This diagnostic is not a portable proof certificate or a complete SymPy compatibility profile. Arithmetic source strings are conservatively refused; structured symbolic objects retain the normal mathematical lane.
checksol.validation_before_last_patch: The previous 17-test version passed py_compile and whitespace checks; isolated upstream SymPy 1.14 oracle checks informed the reported common expected outcomes.
checksol.preservation: The last bounded collection/scalar-input patch applied locally before disconnection. Its exact source was recovered from the tool transcript and GitHub blob readback matched the recovered content. Readback is not syntax/runtime validation.
